instruction: A vast orbital hangar bay: a docked shuttle on a landing cradle, gantry arms and fuel lines, stacked cargo crates with glowing labels, a robotic loader arm at work, blinking control consoles behind glass, warning stripes on the deck, a massive bay window revealing Earth slowly rotating below, and drifting maintenance drones with running lights.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Space Station Hangar Bay. A vast orbital hangar bay: a docked shuttle on a landing cradle, gantry arms and fuel lines, stacked cargo crates with glowing labels, a robotic loader arm at work, blinking control consoles behind glass, warning stripes on the deck, a massive bay window revealing Earth slowly rotating below, and drifting maintenance drones with running lights. Style: clean industrial sci-fi. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
